decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan Dated 26.05.2026Existing and Proposed Block Plan EP001	Dated 19.08.2025Existing Floor Plans	E001 20.04.2026Existing Front & Rear Elevations P002 Dated 20.04.2026Existing Elevations E003 Dated 20.04.2026Existing Side Elevations E004 Dated 20.04.2026Proposed Floor Plans P001 Dated 19.05.2026Proposed Section Plan P004 Dated 08.05.2026Flood Risk Assessment LE2026525FRA R01 Dated May 2026SUDS Pro Forma;Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than six residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect neighbouring residential amenity or the character of the immediate area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen and dining/living rooms shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the occupiers of adjoining premises; protect the general environment; prevent any obstruction to pedestrian movement and to ensure that there are adequate facilities for the storage and recycling of recoverable materials.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

Prior to the first occupation of the HMO, and prior to the commencement of construction of the single-storey rear extension hereby approved, detailed elevation drawings of the extension shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The drawings shall clearly show the design, position and dimensions of the proposed rear patio doors and shall include windows within the side elevation wall serving the kitchen. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details and the approved openings shall be installed prior to the first occupation of the HMO and retained thereafter. Reason: To ensure that the proposed kitchen is provided with adequate levels of natural daylight and outlook, thereby securing a satisfactory standard of residential accommodation for future occupiers.

Prior to the commencement of construction of the single-storey rear extension, rear dormer, outrigger dormer and front rooflights hereby approved, detailed revised elevation drawings shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The drawings shall accurately reflect the development as approved, including the reduced-size rear extension, rear dormer, outrigger dormer and front rooflights and retained thereafter.Reason: To ensure that the final form of development is clearly defined.
description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C4 (HMO-house in multiple occupation) with associated amenity, cycle and refuse storage involving single storey rear extension with rear dormer and front rooflights.
